title: Change of finite coefficients for compact support
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a
separated finite-type
morphism in the finite-field datum.
Put $A=A_{E,n}$, $B=A_{E,m}$, where $1\leq m\leq n$.
For a bounded constructible complex $K$ of
finite Tor amplitude, the
canonical coefficient comparison is an isomorphism

$$
(Rf_!K)\otimes_A^L B\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\
Rf_!(K\otimes_A^L B).
$$

Here the right side uses $B$-coefficients and
compact support; the map
comes from the tensor
comparison. It is compatible with successive reductions, pullback,
and the counits defining the projection transformation.

proof.text: Fix $c=(j,p)$, so $Rf_!^R=Rp_*^Rj_!^R$ for $R=A,B$. Put $S_T=-\otimes_A^LB$. Lemma [lem-fix-reduction-open-etale-origin] gives bounded etale witnesses for $K,j_!^AK,S_XK,j_!^BS_XK$ and for the underlying tensor of $j_!^AK$ with B.

source.place: Tags 0GL5, lemma-projection-formula-Rf-lower-shriek, and 0GL6, remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings; assembly through the fixed compactification

proof.text: Use the B-linear mates chi and beta of [lem-fix-proetale-scalar-mate-normalization] and [lem-fix-open-scalar-tensor-normalization]. By [lem-fix-proper-etale-origin-scalar-isomorphism], $\chi_{p,j_!^AK}$ is invertible. Hence $q_f=(Rp_*^B\beta_j)\chi_{p,j_!^AK}$ is invertible. Their normalization and [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars] identify its restriction with exactly the compactified tensor map of [def-exchange-projection].

source.place: Tags 0GL5, lemma-projection-formula-Rf-lower-shriek, and 0GL6, remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings; assembly through the fixed compactification

proof.text: For $A\to B\to C$, substitute the proper-mate cocycle [lem-pur-ringed-coefficient-projection-cocycle] and the beta cocycle [lem-fix-open-scalar-tensor-normalization] in this formula for $q_f$. Naturality moves beta past chi; the resulting composite is $q_f^{A,C}$ under balanced associativity. Both cited cocycles include identity reductions.

source.place: Tags 0GL5, lemma-projection-formula-Rf-lower-shriek, and 0GL6, remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings; assembly through the fixed compactification

proof.text: For arbitrary base change g, with $c'=(j',p')$ the base change of $c$, define $\operatorname{Ex}_!^R$ ($R=A,B$) as the ambient proper exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] on $j_!^RK$ followed by $Rp'_*{}^R$ of the open base-change isomorphism [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change]; for separated finite-type g this is the formula of [def-exchange-projection]. The proper square [lem-fix-direct-image-scalar-exchange] and open square [lem-fix-open-scalar-exchange] apply to these same chi and beta. Substitute $q_f=Rp_*^B(\beta_j)\chi_p$; naturality moves beta through the proper exchange, then the open square inside $Rp'_*{}^B$ gives $\operatorname{Ex}_!^B g^{-1}q_f=q_{f'}S(\operatorname{Ex}_!^A)$, with the canonical lambda identifications.

source.place: Tags 0GL5, lemma-projection-formula-Rf-lower-shriek, and 0GL6, remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings; assembly through the fixed compactification

proof.text: These are the geometric exchanges: proper factors are qcqs by [pqf-lem-proper-basic]. On the bounded witnesses of step 1, [lem-weil-pbc-transport-identifies-exchange] identifies the proper factor, and [lem-fix-site-open-exchange] the open factor, with their transported etale maps. Composing their squares gives exactly [def-cbc-exchange-map]; [thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale] identifies this composite with the geometric pullback exchange for both A and B.

source.place: Tags 0GL5, lemma-projection-formula-Rf-lower-shriek, and 0GL6, remark-Rf-lower-shriek-change-of-rings; assembly through the fixed compactification

proof.text: The counit identity is the one in [lem-fix-proetale-scalar-mate-normalization]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence] to the coefficient-ring square for p and arbitrary Q. It makes chi preserve the proper projection map. The mixed square [lem-fix-open-scalar-tensor-normalization] does the same for beta and the open projection. Compose these squares in [def-exchange-projection]'s formula to obtain the asserted compact-support projection and counit compatibility.

lean.note: The published pro-etale universal tensor interface remains imported unchanged. It did not supply ordinary-etale coefficient maps needed by this item. This module supplies their exact universal B-linear adjuncts, normalized by open-unit and proper direct-image comparisons, plus the bounded tensor and site-origin domain interfaces. The model universal property is the existing Sheaf.IsDerivedBaseChange; no arbitrary comparison maps or hollow choices are introduced.
